item.title: Parquet en Bambou : élégance Durable pour Votre Intérieur
item.source: Parquet en Bambou : élégance Durable pour Votre Intérieur
item.description:
Le parquet en bambou est une option de revêtement de sol qui allie esthétique, durabilité et respect de l’environnement. Avec une superficie d’utilisation croissante dans les maisons contemporaines, ce matériau devient rapidement un choix prisé pour ceux qui aspirent à un intérieur élégant et durable.

Fabrication

Fabriqué à partir de bambou, une plante à croissance rapide, ce revêtement bénéficie d’un processus de production innovant et durable. Le bambou est récolté après trois à cinq ans, garantissant une ressource renouvelable sans déforestation. La fabrication de notre parquet commence par la préparation des tiges de bambou, qui sont ensuite coupées et traitées pour resister aux nuisibles et à l’humidité. Ces lamelles sont ensuite stratifiées à haute pression, offrant un produit final robuste et durable. Ce processus assure non seulement l’esthétique unique de chaque lame, mais aussi sa résistance aux impacts et aux rayures.

Tailles Disponibles

Nous proposons notre parquet en bambou dans plusieurs tailles pour répondre aux différents besoins et préférences de nos clients :

Largeur : De 10 à 20 cm
Longueur : De 120 à 240 cm
épaisseur : 12 mm ou 15 mm, selon l’usage souhaité

Avantages Principaux

Durabilité : Le bambou est parmi les matériaux les plus durs disponibles sur le marché, surpassant de nombreux types de bois traditionnels. Sa résistance aux chocs et aux éraflures en fait un choix parfait pour les zones à fort passage.

Facilité d’entretien : Le parquet en bambou est facile à nettoyer, nécessitant simplement un balayage régulière et un nettoyage avec une solution douce. Son traitement anti-humidité le rend également résistant aux moisissures.

Esthétique Moderne : Avec son aspect naturel et ses teintes variées allant du clair au foncé, le parquet en bambou s’intègre parfaitement à tout type de décor, du style minimaliste au design rustique.

Confort : Le bambou a une chaleur naturelle qui rend les sols agréables au toucher, ce qui est particulièrement apprécié durant les mois plus froids.

Installation Recommandée

Pour garantir la durabilité de votre parquet en bambou, une installation professionnelle est souvent recommandée. Voici quelques étapes clés à suivre :

Préparation du sol : Assurez-vous que le sous-plancher est propre, sec et de niveau.

Acclimatation : Laissez les lames de bambou s’acclimater dans la pièce où elles seront installées pendant au moins 48 heures pour éviter les déformations après installation.

Méthode de pose : Nous recommandons une installation flottante pour une facilité de pose et un bon résultat esthétique. L’utilisation de sous-couches peut également améliorer l’isolation et le confort.

Points de Préoccupation des Clients Allemands

Impact Environnemental : Beaucoup d’acheteurs sont sensibles à la provenance du bambou. Assurez-vous d’acheter auprès de fabricants certifiés qui respectent des pratiques durables.

Le parquet en bambou est plus qu’un simple choix esthétique ; c’est une décision écologique et durable qui offre une multitude d’avantages pour votre maison. Pratique, élégant et respectueux de l’environnement, il constitue un excellent choix pour tout type d’intérieur. Faites de votre espace de vie un lieu chaleureux et accueillant avec notre parquet en bambou.

item.title: 縦目ナチュラル竹フローリング
item.source: 縦目ナチュラル竹フローリング
item.description:
縦目ナチュラル竹フローリングは、竹の繊維を縦方向に整列させ高圧圧縮して成形した、高耐久かつ洗練された質感を持つプレミアム床材です。竹本来の自然な色味と繊細な繊維の流れを生かし、空間を明るく上質に仕上げることから、住宅から商業施設まで幅広い用途で選ばれています。

製造工程では、成熟した竹を厳選して細胞構造を均一に加工し、縦方向に並べた板材を高温?高圧で接着?プレスします。この縦目構造は、竹が持つ本来の強度を最大限に引き出し、膨張?収縮の少ない安定したフローリングを実現します。さらに、自然由来の硬化塗装やUV仕上げを施すことで、耐摩耗性?耐傷性が向上し、日常の使用にも長期間耐える品質が確保されています。

利用可能なサイズは、一般住宅向けの標準幅から大空間に適したワイドサイズまで幅広くラインナップ。一般的には以下のような仕様が選ばれています。

厚さ：15mm
幅：96mm
長さ：960mm

 これらのサイズ展開により、空間デザインや施工条件に合わせた柔軟な選択が可能です。

本製品の大きな特徴は、竹特有の高い硬度と寸法安定性にあります。竹は再生速度が非常に速い環境配慮型の素材にもかかわらず、硬度は多くの広葉樹より高く、耐摩耗性にも優れています。特に縦目構造は、足触りの滑らかさと視覚的なストレートラインの美しさを兼ね備えており、近年人気が高まっています。また、ナチュラルカラーは時間の経過とともに落ち着いた風合いを増し、長期にわたり美しく使い続けることができます。

推奨される施工方法には、直貼り工法または捨て貼り工法が挙げられます。コンクリート下地の場合は、専用接着剤を用いた直貼りが一般的で、床暖房にも対応できる仕様が多く含まれます。木質下地の場合は、合板を下地として捨て貼りし、フローリングを釘?接着剤で固定する方法が安定性に優れます。いずれの場合も、施工前の湿度管理と下地調整が良質な仕上がりのために非常に重要です。

縦目ナチュラル竹フローリングは、高い耐久性、環境性能、美しい自然素材の質感を兼ね備えた、現代の住空間に最適な床材です。シンプルでありながら存在感のあるデザインが、あらゆるインテリアに調和し、快適で長く愛せる空間づくりを実現します。

item.title: Bamboo Plywood
item.description:
Bamboo plywood is a special trade name for bamboo panels, actually, bamboo panels are exactly same product with bamboo plywood, just 2 different names. Bamboo plywood is a common and popular name for US and Canada market, for rest of world, bamboo panels are first choice.


Bamboo plywood has 4 basic thickness: 1/4", 1/2", 3/4" and 1". Grains are horizontal, vertical and strand woven. Colors are natural, caramel, tiger and chocolate.


Bamboo panels have 8 basic thickness: 5mm, 10mm, 15mm, 20mm, 25mm, 30mm, 35mm and 40mm.






Horizontal Natural

Horizontal Caramel

Vertical Natural

Vertical Caramel


Bamboo looks like wood, feels like wood, and cuts like wood. It even smells like wood. But bamboo is not wood, it is a fast-growing and sturdy tree-like grass, which is an environmentally friendly, renewable resource.


Bamboo plywood has gained a lot of attention recently, especially among “green” building professionals and architects. Bamboo plywood is multi-purpose building and decoration material because they are environmentally green, easy to mill, stable structure, adjustable dimension, consistent top quality, making it ideal for a wide range of uses including countertops, cabinets, desks, shelving, architectural panels, and much more.


Bamboo Plywood Manufacturing Process:


Step 1: Treatment with bamboo strips. After harvesting, bamboo pole is cut into stalks and strips. All strips need be boiled in a water and boric acid solution. This removes sugars from the stalks which is necessary because sugars attract termites. This boiling process also stops the growth of fungus and mold. With few hours boiling, bamboo strips will be sent into dry kiln to get a very low moisture content - less than 10%, too wet strips are not possible for gluing and pressing.


Step 2: Laminated bamboo into boards. After well-processed for strips, bamboo will be glued with a urea-formaldehyde (UF) adhesive which emits very low volatile organic compound (VOC). Glued bamboo strips are laminated into layer of board by a 800-ton presser with hot steam. Multiple layers are formed to thick and suitable construction boards with a 1500-ton presser at cold condition, no steam, just static pressure.


Step 3: Sanding and cutting bamboo panels. Surface of bamboo boards are unsmooth after lamination, size of boards are imprecise. It takes twice sanding for both sides of every panel, first sanding is with 200 mesh paper and second is 120 mesh. All bamboo panels need be trimmed to ensure 4 sides are flat and square.


Bamboo Plywood Application:


- Thickness of 40mm is best choice for making bamboo door, strong and safe enough.


- Thickness of 20mm and 30mm is thick enough for making bamboo stairs.


- Thickness of 15mm and 20mm is ideal and capable for making bamboo cabinet.

item.title: Bamboo Decking : Profile A : Xtr
item.description:
Bamboo Decking Profile A:


  - One side small groove or ribbon, one side flat or smooth;

  - Grooves on both edges;

  - Color is darker caramel;


 





Stronger, greener and harder than composite decking, a bamboo deck makes an excellent choice to replace an existing deck or install a new deck in your home. Aesthetically pleasing, ecologically-friendly, durable, easy to install and moisture resistant, bamboo decking transforms your yard and adds a new dimension to your exterior décor. Bamboo decking is made of strand woven bamboo with outdoor glue and oil.


Strand woven bamboo is produced by stripping mature Mao bamboo stalks. The reason why this particular part of the process is environmentally friendly is because 100% of the harvested stalk is used and there is zero waste. These stalks are boiled in a water and boric acid solution. This removes sugars from the stalks which is necessary because sugars attract termites. This boiling process also stops the growth of fungus and mold. Any insects in the bamboo will also be removed. Often, copper sulfate is used to kill any micro-organisms. This stuff is incredibly toxic. Then the strips are dried and woven with an extremely low Volatile Organic Compound (VOC) plasticizer or glue. The woven strand is crushed in a 2000-ton heat press and now becomes a strand woven board. This strand woven board is then milled in a laser-guided mill that accurately cuts each board.


Bamboo Decking Features:


1) Environmental friendly, bamboo is one of the fastest growing grasses on the planet that can grow to approximately 80 feet in 5-7 years.


2) High density and hardness (between density 1100 and 1200 kg/m3, almost twice than the density of oak). Bamboo is a highly dense and strong material.


3) Resists all types of weather as bamboo decks are oiled with top brand and quality-guaranteed oil only.


4) 10 Years warranty against mould, rot, delamination, fugal attack and termites.


Bamboo Decking Installation:


It has 2 basic installation methods, metal clip or screw down, but both of methods need the joist or rips. Joist is to be screwed down on the ground, the distance between 2 joists is 45-60cm. Joist in strand woven bamboo or vertical bamboo is available as well. Bamboo decking planks will be fixed on the joist in 2 solutions.


Option 1, using a stainless steel clip to connect 2 planks, then screwing the clip on the joist, after connecting, the gap between 2 planks is 1cm, the planks need have grooves on both sides.


Option 2, screwing the planks on the joist directly, please be noted that the plank is 20mm thickness and thickness is 1100kg/m3, it will take a lot of power to make that work.

item.title: Solid : Horizontal : Natural
item.description:
Horizontal grain is flat-pressed style, bamboo strips are placed into three layers on top of one another, horizontal displays the natural nodes or knuckles of the bamboo. These nodes are randomly visible on the surface, adding to the natural beauty of the floor. Horizontal features more of the unique properties of the bamboo grass, with more visible nodes (the characteristic joint in the bamboo cane).


Natural bamboo is a light-yellow and original bamboo color, and is rich, creamy, golden blonde shade. This light-honey shade proudly displays the bamboo‘s beautiful grain, growth patterns, and joints, giving any room a more luxurious feel.


Solid bamboo flooring is exactly how it sounds: solid. This style of flooring will give you the most natural, rustic look of the plant, as the interesting grains and patterns will stand out along the flooring surface. Solid bamboo flooring visualizations spotless stability, chick lines, and critical simplicity create this magnificent flooring as one of terrific design idea. Solid bamboo flooring compromise comfortable publicity incorporate color distribution, element connection, design blend involvement and design plan format, which the whole phase mix together to create fantastic flooring.


Solid Bamboo Flooring Manufacturing Process:


Step 1: After harvesting, bamboo is cut into strips. These strips are boiled in a water and boric acid solution. This removes sugars from the stalks which is necessary because sugars attract termites. This boiling process also stops the growth of fungus and mold. Any insects in the bamboo will also be removed.


Step 2: The process of steaming bamboo material under a controlled pressure and temperature is called carbonization, in which bio-organisms and sugar breaks down, and the color of the material darkens.


Step 3: All bamboo strips will be dried in the dry kiln to make the moisture content to be less than 10%. Lower moisture on bamboo strips, higher stability on bamboo flooring.


Step 4: A stringent selection process ensures only premium strips will be used for bamboo flooring. Selected strips are stacked in layers and glued with an environmentally safe adhesive prior to being put through a 1250 ton press to form planks.


Step 5: This plank is then milled in a computerized mill that accurately cuts each board. After the boards are milled, they are sanded and coated with aluminum oxide finish.


Bamboo Flooring Features:


1) Environmentally Friendly - Solid flooring construction, made from 100% rapidly renewable and sustainable Moso bamboo which is one of the fastest-growing plants in the world. Bamboo can be harvested for flooring production after just four or five years. Bamboo qualifies for 2 LEED credits.


2) Indoor Air Quality - Extremely low emission levels, lower than WHO (World Health Organization) and CARB (California Air Resources Board) standards. LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) and GECA (Good Environmental Choice Award) accredited. (0.05ppm, E1).


3) Coating - Ten stage Klumpp coating system with ‘Anti-Scratch’ finish utilizing the latest scratch resistant technology combined with an advanced co-polymer primer for optimum finish adhesion. (5H scratch resistant, 5B cross hatch adhesion).


4) Tough & Durable - Bamboo looks like wood, feels like wood, and cuts like wood. It even smells like wood. Horizontal bamboo and vertical bamboo have Janka rating of 7.5, oak has Janka rating of 5.5, Ipe has Janka rating of 16.2.

Strand Woven Bamboo Flooring Manufacturing Process:


Step 1: Dried bamboo poles are shredded into fine strips, dissecting and opening the cell structure of the plant.


Step 2: The bamboo strips are immersed in non-toxic, water based glue, which fills and encapsulates the exposed cells.


Step 3: A precisely measured quantity of bamboo strips is fused together under the high pressure of a 2500-ton cold press, producing blocks similar in size and shape to railroad ties. The cold press uses no heat and no toxic or harmful chemicals.


Step 4: The solid block is left to stabilize in a resting position for 30 days before being processed into flooring material.

item.title: Strand Woven : Solid : Caramel
item.description:
Carbonized Strand Woven Bamboo - Carbonization is the process where the fiber are heated until they darken in color. These planks are then pre-finished with the 8 layer aluminum oxide/ polyurethane coating.


Strand Woven Bamboo is the hardest floor available today as can be seen from the official Janka Test results - Janka Hardness Rating of 3000 PSI, it has a highly distinctive grain with a look resembling that of traditional teak hardwoods. Strand woven bamboo made using a unique manufacturing process that is different from all other bamboo flooring types – by heating long strands of bamboo, and compressing them under extreme pressure, to achieve highest density and most beautiful color.


Strand Woven Bamboo Flooring Manufacturing Process:


Step 1: Dried bamboo poles are shredded into fine strips, dissecting and opening the cell structure of the plant.


Step 2: The bamboo strips are immersed in non-toxic, water based glue, which fills and encapsulates the exposed cells.


Step 3: A precisely measured quantity of bamboo strips is fused together under the high pressure of a 2500-ton cold press, producing blocks similar in size and shape to railroad ties. The cold press uses no heat and no toxic or harmful chemicals.


Step 4: The solid block is left to stabilize in a resting position for 30 days before being processed into flooring material.


Strand Woven Bamboo Flooring Features:


1) Cold Pressed – our Bamboo flooring produced with Cold Press process, which can achieve greater uniformity in density, color and moisture content, as well as a more appealing appearance.


2) Value – much more higher density than hardwood timber but reasonably prices as bamboo is technically a grass, one of the strongest materials in the world and fast-growing renewable material.


3) Termite resistant – 100% resistant to termites as bamboo has been well treated with the boiling and drying to remove sugar and insects.


4) Healthy – No toxic fumes. With 0.01mg formaldehyde per cubic meter of air (<E1), the adhesive used to laminate the Bamboo strips that form the flooring. Off-gases 16% less than the European Standards (EN) of 0.13mg.


5) Easy Maintenance – Requires no special cleaning treatment, Just sweep or vacuum regularly to remove dust and dirt. Damp mop or clean occasionally. Yearly wax/oil.

Solid Wide Plank Bamboo Flooring Manufacturing Process:


Step 1: After harvesting, bamboo is cut into strips. These strips are boiled in a water and boric acid solution. This removes sugars from the stalks which is necessary because sugars attract termites. This boiling process also stops the growth of fungus and mold. Any insects in the bamboo will also be removed.


Step 2: The process of steaming bamboo material under a controlled pressure and temperature is called carbonization, in which bio-organisms and sugar breaks down, and the color of the material darkens.


Step 3: All bamboo strips will be dried in the dry kiln to make the moisture content to be less than 10%. Lower moisture on bamboo strips, higher stability on bamboo flooring.


Step 4: A stringent selection process ensures only premium strips will be used for bamboo flooring. Selected strips are stacked in layers and glued with an environmentally safe adhesive prior to being put through a 1250 ton press to form planks.


Step 5: This plank is then milled in a computerized mill that accurately cuts each board. After the boards are milled, they are sanded and coated with aluminum oxide finish.


Bamboo Flooring Features:

item.title: Bamboo Decking : Profile G : 30MM
item.description:
Bamboo Decking Profile G:


  - One side deep groove or ribbon, one side flat or smooth;

  - Grooves on both edges;

  - Color is xtreme;






Stronger, greener and harder than composite decking, a bamboo deck makes an excellent choice to replace an existing deck or install a new deck in your home. Aesthetically pleasing, ecologically-friendly, durable, easy to install and moisture resistant, bamboo decking transforms your yard and adds a new dimension to your exterior décor. Bamboo decking is made of strand woven bamboo with outdoor glue and oil.


Strand woven bamboo is produced by stripping mature Mao bamboo stalks. The reason why this particular part of the process is environmentally friendly is because 100% of the harvested stalk is used and there is zero waste. These stalks are boiled in a water and boric acid solution. This removes sugars from the stalks which is necessary because sugars attract termites. This boiling process also stops the growth of fungus and mold. Any insects in the bamboo will also be removed. Often, copper sulfate is used to kill any micro-organisms. This stuff is incredibly toxic. Then the strips are dried and woven with an extremely low Volatile Organic Compound (VOC) plasticizer or glue. The woven strand is crushed in a 2000-ton heat press and now becomes a strand woven board. This strand woven board is then milled in a laser-guided mill that accurately cuts each board.


Bamboo Decking Features:


1) Environmental friendly, bamboo is one of the fastest growing grasses on the planet that can grow to approximately 80 feet in 5-7 years.


2) High density and hardness (between density 1100 and 1200 kg/m3, almost twice than the density of oak). Bamboo is a highly dense and strong material.


3) Resists all types of weather as bamboo decks are oiled with top brand and quality-guaranteed oil only.


4) 10 Years warranty against mould, rot, delamination, fugal attack and termites.


Bamboo Decking Installation:


It has 2 basic installation methods, metal clip or screw down, but both of methods need the joist or rips. Joist is to be screwed down on the ground, the distance between 2 joists is 45-60cm. Joist in strand woven bamboo or vertical bamboo is available as well. Bamboo decking planks will be fixed on the joist in 2 solutions.


Option 1, using a stainless steel clip to connect 2 planks, then screwing the clip on the joist, after connecting, the gap between 2 planks is 1cm, the planks need have grooves on both sides.


Option 2, screwing the planks on the joist directly, please be noted that the plank is 20mm thickness and thickness is 1100kg/m3, it will take a lot of power to make that work.

item.title: Bamboo Decking : Profile F : Caramel
item.description:
Bamboo Decking Profile F:


  - One side small groove or ribbon, one side flat or smooth;

  - Grooves on both edges;

  - Color is caramel;






Stronger, greener and harder than composite decking, a bamboo deck makes an excellent choice to replace an existing deck or install a new deck in your home. Aesthetically pleasing, ecologically-friendly, durable, easy to install and moisture resistant, bamboo decking transforms your yard and adds a new dimension to your exterior décor. Bamboo decking is made of strand woven bamboo with outdoor glue and oil.


Strand woven bamboo is produced by stripping mature Mao bamboo stalks. The reason why this particular part of the process is environmentally friendly is because 100% of the harvested stalk is used and there is zero waste. These stalks are boiled in a water and boric acid solution. This removes sugars from the stalks which is necessary because sugars attract termites. This boiling process also stops the growth of fungus and mold. Any insects in the bamboo will also be removed. Often, copper sulfate is used to kill any micro-organisms. This stuff is incredibly toxic. Then the strips are dried and woven with an extremely low Volatile Organic Compound (VOC) plasticizer or glue. The woven strand is crushed in a 2000-ton heat press and now becomes a strand woven board. This strand woven board is then milled in a laser-guided mill that accurately cuts each board.


Bamboo Decking Features:


1) Environmental friendly, bamboo is one of the fastest growing grasses on the planet that can grow to approximately 80 feet in 5-7 years.


2) High density and hardness (between density 1100 and 1200 kg/m3, almost twice than the density of oak). Bamboo is a highly dense and strong material.


3) Resists all types of weather as bamboo decks are oiled with top brand and quality-guaranteed oil only.


4) 10 Years warranty against mould, rot, delamination, fugal attack and termites.


Bamboo Decking Installation:


It has 2 basic installation methods, metal clip or screw down, but both of methods need the joist or rips. Joist is to be screwed down on the ground, the distance between 2 joists is 45-60cm. Joist in strand woven bamboo or vertical bamboo is available as well. Bamboo decking planks will be fixed on the joist in 2 solutions.


Option 1, using a stainless steel clip to connect 2 planks, then screwing the clip on the joist, after connecting, the gap between 2 planks is 1cm, the planks need have grooves on both sides.


Option 2, screwing the planks on the joist directly, please be noted that the plank is 20mm thickness and thickness is 1100kg/m3, it will take a lot of power to make that work.

Bamboo panels are multi-purpose building and decoration material because they are environmentally green, easy to mill, stable structure, adjustable dimension, consistent top quality, making it ideal for a wide range of uses including countertops, cabinets, desks, shelving, architectural panels, and much more.


Bamboo Panels Manufacturing Process:

item.title: Bamboo Veneer : 0.6MM : HC
item.description:
Bamboo veneer‘s major material is Moso bamboo which is famous in the earth for its strength and straightness, sliced from laminated bamboo blocks by using exclusive patented technology. Bamboo veneer is an innovative and elegant addition to the world of interior decoration and furniture design. This material offers a unique design concept and works well for a wide range of interior uses including architectural panels, countertops, furniture, millwork, cabinetry, and store fixtures.


Bamboo Veneer Manufacturing Process:


Step 1: Treatment with bamboo strips. After harvesting, bamboo pole is cut into stalks and strips. All strips need be boiled in a water and boric acid solution. This removes sugars from the stalks which is necessary because sugars attract termites. This boiling process also stops the growth of fungus and mold. With few hours boiling, bamboo strips will be sent into dry kiln to get a very low moisture content - less than 10%, too wet strips are not possible for gluing and pressing.


Step 2: Laminated bamboo into blocks. After well-processed for strips, bamboo will be glued with a urea-formaldehyde (UF) adhesive which emits very low volatile organic compound (VOC). Glued bamboo strips are laminated into layers of board by a 1200-ton presser with hot steam. The big blocks will be conditioned and soaked for two weeks.


Step 3: Slicing, drying and backing. After soaked, bamboo blocks are soft and easy to be sliced into veneer sheets. All sliced sheets are still wet and need be dried before backing with cellulose fleece which gives the veneer more stability and strength. Producing un-backed veneers is possible, but very fragile and hard to transport, this can result in a lower yield due to damaged material.


Step 4: Veneer joining and color selection. Original veneer width after slice is 430mm and 3 sheets are to be joined by Kuper Longitudinal splicer to achieve 1250mm width. All sheets with defects are selected out and extremely light or dark colours are sorted out and marked on cartons.


Bamboo Veneer Features:


1) Flexible and strong (Backed with Cellulose fleece)


2) Bonded with D3 water-resistant PVAc glue, which has good resistance against temperature and humidity


3) High tear resistance combined with high flexibility


4) No penetration of glue, bonds well with different types of glue: PVA, hotmelt, contact adhesives

item.title: Bamboo Tile : Strand Woven : Xtr
item.description:
Bamboo tile is small cut from outdoor strand woven bamboo block, same material of decking production, one of best, strongest, sustainable material for exterior and outdoor. Strand woven bamboo derived directly from the pole of the Moso bamboo plant which has a tensile strength superior to cold rolled steel and a compressive strength higher than concrete. Bamboo tile has wide applications, for garden, park, bathroom, which need a material with long lasting, no moldy, antibacterial, antimicrobial and anti-fungal.


Strand Woven Bamboo Tile Manufacturing Process:


Step 1: Dried bamboo poles are shredded into fine strips, dissecting and opening the cell structure of the plant.


Step 2: The bamboo strips are immersed in non-toxic, water based glue, which fills and encapsulates the exposed cells.


Step 3: A precisely measured quantity of bamboo strips is fused together under the high pressure of a 2500-ton cold press, producing blocks similar in size and shape to railroad ties. The cold press uses no heat and no toxic or harmful chemicals.


Step 4: The solid block is left to stabilize in a resting position for 30 days before being processed into flooring material.


Step 5: Slice the woven block into flooring planks, sand the planks to be smooth, mill the grooves on the surface, put the oil on.


Step 6: Assemble the bamboo with the plastic platform.

item.title: Bamboo Decking : Joist : Caramel
item.description:
Bamboo decking joist is same material of decking board which is strand woven bamboo, standard carbonized and xtr are both available to match with bamboo decking. Bamboo joists are more environmentally and ecofriendly compared than wood joists because bamboo is renewable materials and fast growing than hardwood. Bamboo joist is stronger and durable than preservative wood because of higher density and hardness.


One square meter of bamboo decking need use 3.8 meters of joist. Bamboo joist need be nailed down on the ground, then put the decking board on the joist, screwed down the stainless steel clips on the joist.


Stronger, greener and harder than composite decking, a bamboo deck makes an excellent choice to replace an existing deck or install a new deck in your home. Aesthetically pleasing, ecologically-friendly, durable, easy to install and moisture resistant, bamboo decking transforms your yard and adds a new dimension to your exterior décor. Bamboo decking is made of strand woven bamboo with outdoor glue and oil.


Strand woven bamboo is produced by stripping mature Mao bamboo stalks. The reason why this particular part of the process is environmentally friendly is because 100% of the harvested stalk is used and there is zero waste. These stalks are boiled in a water and boric acid solution. This removes sugars from the stalks which is necessary because sugars attract termites. This boiling process also stops the growth of fungus and mold. Any insects in the bamboo will also be removed. Often, copper sulfate is used to kill any micro-organisms. This stuff is incredibly toxic. Then the strips are dried and woven with an extremely low Volatile Organic Compound (VOC) plasticizer or glue. The woven strand is crushed in a 2000-ton heat press and now becomes a strand woven board. This strand woven board is then milled in a laser-guided mill that accurately cuts each board.


Bamboo Decking Features:


1) Environmental friendly, bamboo is one of the fastest growing grasses on the planet that can grow to approximately 80 feet in 5-7 years.


2) High density and hardness (between density 1100 and 1200 kg/m3, almost twice than the density of oak). Bamboo is a highly dense and strong material.


3) Resists all types of weather as bamboo decks are oiled with top brand and quality-guaranteed oil only.


4) 10 Years warranty against mould, rot, delamination, fugal attack and termites.


Bamboo Decking Installation:


It has 2 basic installation methods, metal clip or screw down, but both of methods need the joist or rips. Joist is to be screwed down on the ground, the distance between 2 joists is 45-60cm. Joist in strand woven bamboo or vertical bamboo is available as well. Bamboo decking planks will be fixed on the joist in 2 solutions.


Option 1, using a stainless steel clip to connect 2 planks, then screwing the clip on the joist, after connecting, the gap between 2 planks is 1cm, the planks need have grooves on both sides.


Option 2, screwing the planks on the joist directly, please be noted that the plank is 20mm thickness and thickness is 1100kg/m3, it will take a lot of power to make that work.

Bamboo looks like wood, feels like wood, and cuts like wood. It even smells like wood. But bamboo is not wood, it is a fast-growing and sturdy tree-like grass, which is an environmentally friendly, renewable resource.


Bamboo panels have gained a lot of attention recently, especially among “green” building professionals and architects. Bamboo panels are multi-purpose building and decoration material because they are environmentally green, easy to mill, stable structure, adjustable dimension, consistent top quality, making it ideal for a wide range of uses including countertops, cabinets, desks, shelving, architectural panels, and much more.


Bamboo Panels Manufacturing Process:


Step 1: Treatment with bamboo strips. After harvesting, bamboo pole is cut into stalks and strips. All strips need be boiled in a water and boric acid solution. This removes sugars from the stalks which is necessary because sugars attract termites. This boiling process also stops the growth of fungus and mold. With few hours boiling, bamboo strips will be sent into dry kiln to get a very low moisture content - less than 10%, too wet strips are not possible for gluing and pressing.


Step 2: Laminated bamboo into boards. After well-processed for strips, bamboo will be glued with a urea-formaldehyde (UF) adhesive which emits very low volatile organic compound (VOC). Glued bamboo strips are laminated into layer of board by a 800-ton presser with hot steam. Multiple layers are formed to thick and suitable construction boards with a 1500-ton presser at cold condition, no steam, just static pressure.


Step 3: Sanding and cutting bamboo panels. Surface of bamboo boards are unsmooth after lamination, size of boards are imprecise. It takes twice sanding for both sides of every panel, first sanding is with 200 mesh paper and second is 120 mesh. All bamboo panels need be trimmed to ensure 4 sides are flat and square.

Bamboo panel is a truly green and environmental material for building the house, making the furniture – door, cabinet, kitchen etc., milling the stairs, creating new, unique and fabulous bamboos with panels distinct advantages – stable structure, superior density, elegant colors, easy processing and adjustable dimensions.

item.description:

Click Strand Woven Bamboo Flooring Manufacturing Process:


Step 1: Dried bamboo poles are shredded into fine strips, dissecting and opening the cell structure of the plant.

Step 3: A precisely measured quantity of bamboo strips is fused together under the high pressure of a 2500-ton cold press, producing blocks similar in size and shape to railroad ties. The cold press uses no heat and no toxic or harmful chemicals.


Step 4: The solid block is left to stabilize in a resting position for 30 days before being processed into flooring material.

3) Termite resistant – 100% resistant to termites as bamboo has been well treated with the boiling and drying to remove sugar and insects.


4) Healthy – No toxic fumes. With 0.01mg formaldehyde per cubic meter of air (<E1), the adhesive used to laminate the Bamboo strips that form the flooring. Off-gases 16% less than the European Standards (EN) of 0.13mg.
